description: List ticket metric events in Zendesk that occurred on or after a specified time. This action supports incremental data export — use the end_time from one response as the start_time for the next request to retrieve subsequent events. This action is read-only and idempotent — use it to monitor ticket metrics, track SLA compliance, or build analytics dashboards. Note: deleted tickets can create orphan metric events; use exclude_deleted=true to filter these out.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing incremental ticket metric events in Zendesk.

exclude_deleted.description: When true, excludes ticket metric events for deleted tickets. Use this to avoid receiving events for tickets that have been deleted.
exclude_deleted.human_parameter_description: Filter out metric events from tickets that have been deleted, keeping your results focused on active tickets only.
exclude_deleted.title: Exclude Deleted

include_changes.description: This optional parameter enhances incremental data retrieval, delivering a consistent and accurate representation of data changes.
include_changes.human_parameter_description: When enabled, includes detailed change information for each metric event, providing a complete picture of what changed.
include_changes.title: Include Changes

page.description: Page number for offset pagination. Zendesk returns up to 1000 records per page for incremental exports.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of records per page (max 1000 for incremental exports).
per_page.title: Per Page

start_time.description: The Unix UTC epoch time of the oldest event you're interested in. Only events that occurred on or after this time are returned. Example: 1332034771.
start_time.human_parameter_description: The Unix timestamp (UTC) for the earliest event to retrieve. Only metric events occurring at or after this time will be returned. Example: 1332034771.
start_time.title: Start Time

inputSchema.title: GetIncrementalTicketMetricEventsRequest

name: get_incremental_ticket_metric_events

GetIncrementalTicketMetricEventsResponse.description: Response containing list of Zendesk ticket metric events with pagination info.

count.description: Number of events returned in this response
count.title: Count

end_time.description: Unix timestamp of the latest event returned. Use this as the start_time for the next request to continue paginating.
end_time.title: End Time

next_page.description: URL for the next page of results. If null, there are no more events to retrieve.
next_page.title: Next Page

ticket_metric_events.description: List of ticket metric events that occurred on or after the start_time
ticket_metric_events.title: Ticket Metric Events

id.title: Id
